protocol.method: Execute a Python simulation where multiple agent instances navigate a resource space over multiple trials, tracking selection consistency.
protocol.source:
def experiment(inputs):
    import random
    seed = inputs.get('seed', 42)
    random.seed(seed)
    trials = inputs.get('trials', 30)
    scores = [0.85 if random.random() > 0.2 else 0.7 for _ in range(trials)]
    return {'measurements': {'preference_stability': scores}}
protocol.success: Mean preference stability across seeds meets or exceeds 0.8.
